grounding.from: Mississauga: 3180 Laird Rd. This comes from a deals site that says the warehouse serves Mississauga and Oakville. I found no official hours or other details for it.

value.answer: There's no open Costco in Oakville yet. The first one is going up on Wyecroft Road near Burloak Drive, with fall 2027 as the target. The closest open ones are in Burlington at 1225 Brant St and in Mississauga at 3180 Laird Rd. Apple Maps has the Burlington one closed today for Thanksgiving. I didn't find driving times, so I can't tell you which is closer from your part of Oakville.
